subject: math
description: Distinguish linear, square, and cubic unit conversions, including why area conversion factors are squared and volume conversion factors are cubed.
learningObjectives: Convert between common SI length units such as centimeters and meters
Distinguish linear units, square units, and cubic units
Convert area measurements by squaring the linear conversion factor
Convert volume measurements by cubing the linear conversion factor
Solve mixed conversion drills involving length, area, and volume units
prerequisites: Multiply and divide by powers of 10
Recognize centimeters, meters, square centimeters, square meters, cubic centimeters, and cubic meters
Find area by multiplying two lengths
Find volume by multiplying three lengths
